# RelayPlan

> A private TypeScript relief allocation simulator. Optimize the worst demand coverage, compare a greedy heuristic, preview direct-route closures and export reproducible scenario and allocation files.

Synthetic tabletop model. No real-time road safety, vehicle scheduling or measured field impact. No backend accounts or scenario database.

## Getting started

- [README](./README.md): Setup, demo exercise, tests, architecture and contributing.

## Model and evidence

- [Algorithm](./docs/ALGORITHM.md): Integer constraints and exact three-level allocation objective.
- [Research](./docs/RESEARCH.md): Problem grounding, established research, alternatives and impact plan.
- [Security](./docs/SECURITY.md): Local trust boundaries, bounded imports and actual review limits.
